headline: Hyperithm is an off-chain digital asset manager curating Morpho vaults; 2 vault addresses, 2 tokenized strategy tokens, and 2 GitHub repositories discovered

findings.text: Etherscan search found mHYPER (0x9b5528528656DBC094765E2abB79F293c21191B9) and mHyperETH (0x5a42864b14C0C8241EF5ab62Dae975b163a2E0C1) tokenized strategy tokens tracking Hyperithm's market-neutral strategies

Website https://www.hyperithm.com and subsite https://vaults.hyperithm.com provide company overview but no formal deployments page with contract addresses; company describes itself as a digital asset manager with quant trading and venture investment operations
No audit links recorded in protocol metadata; audit PDFs not available for inspection

GitHub organization at https://github.com/hyperithm hosts two public repositories: DefiLlama-Adapters (forked) and ethena_sats_adapters_public (forked); DefiLlama adapter reveals morphoVaultOwners address 0x16fa314141C76D4a0675f5e8e3CCBE4E0fA22C7c on Ethereum

No evidence of direct on-chain protocol contracts deployed by Hyperithm across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Monad, Plasma, Hyperliquid L1, Katana, Binance, or XRPL EVM; Hyperithm operates as curator, not protocol developer
Hyperithm manages Morpho vault strategies (not a factory-deployed pool system); single vault address identified: 0x777791C4d6DC2CE140D00D2828a7C93503c67777 (Hyperithm USDC vault on Ethereum mainnet)
Addresses classified: vault (Morpho vault contracts), token (mHYPER, mHyperETH yield tokens tracking strategy performance), and other (curator/manager roles)
All addresses traced to fetched block explorer and GitHub sources; mHYPER and mHyperETH confirmed on Etherscan; vault owner address sourced from fetched DeFiLlama adapter code

rationale.verdict: Hyperithm is an off-chain digital asset manager specializing in Morpho vault curation, not a deployed DeFi protocol with upgradeable contracts or governance tokens. Discovered 2 Morpho vault addresses (curated, not owned), 2 tokenized strategy tokens (mHYPER, mHyperETH), and 2 GitHub repositories. No immutable protocol contracts, no factory, no on-chain governance detected. Assessment constrained by off-chain-only curation model; traditional control/exit/autonomy slices may yield 'unknown' grades due to lack of Hyperithm-owned smart contract infrastructure.

evidence.shows: Official website describing Hyperithm as digital asset manager based in Tokyo/Seoul, engaged in quant trading and venture investments, registered as SPBQII operator in Japan and VASP in Korea
Vaults subdomain redirects to main Hyperithm website; no separate deployments documentation found
GitHub organization with 2 public repositories: DefiLlama-Adapters (forked) and ethena_sats_adapters_public (forked); no original protocol contracts
Forked DefiLlama adapter repository; hyperithm/index.js references morphoVaultOwners address 0x16fa314141C76D4a0675f5e8e3CCBE4E0fA22C7c on Ethereum blockchain

mHYPER (Midas Hyperithm) ERC-20 token: liquid yield token tracking market-neutral, stablecoin-focused strategies monitored by Hyperithm; TransparentUpgradeableProxy implementation at 0x9b5528528656DBC094765E2abB79F293c21191B9
mHyperETH (Midas Hyperithm ETH) ERC-20 token: structured to track performance of ETH-denominated market-neutral strategies; TransparentUpgradeableProxy at 0x5a42864b14C0C8241EF5ab62Dae975b163a2E0C1
Hyperithm USDC Morpho vault at 0x777791C4d6DC2CE140D00D2828a7C93503c67777; vault curator role responsible for setting market allocations and supply caps within underlying Morpho lending markets

Morpho Vaults curated by asset managers including Hyperithm, providing billions in stablecoin liquidity; Midas tokenizes Hyperithm vault strategies (mHYPER, mHyperETH) making them collateralizable on Morpho

Morpho Vault curator role definition: chief risk officer and strategist responsible for defining investment thesis, setting risk parameters, enabling allocator tools, and submitting supply cap changes subject to timelock

unknowns: D2: Official deployed_contracts_doc / deployments page not found; Hyperithm operates as off-chain manager, not protocol developer
D5: Addresses on non-Ethereum chains (Monad, Arbitrum, Plasma, Hyperliquid L1, Katana, Binance, XRPL EVM) not discovered; search limited to Ethereum/DeFiLlama indexed sources
D6: No factory contract enumeration required; Hyperithm does not deploy child contracts

protocol_metadata.about: Hyperithm is a Tokyo and Seoul-based digital asset manager specializing in algorithmic trading and venture investments. It serves as a curator for Morpho Vaults, managing allocations across underlying lending markets and enabling yield generation for depositors. Hyperithm's strategies are tokenized via Midas (mHYPER, mHyperETH tokens), allowing institutional and retail participation in market-neutral, stablecoin-focused or ETH-denominated trading strategies backed by on-chain lending markets.
